title: Warning Cost
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing said coldly: "He is my person, who dares touch him?" The killing intent brimming in those eyes made everyone present instantly understand that this Demonic Path Saint was by no means merely speaking formalities.

text.content:
The will of Heaven's Eye pressed down on Chen Ji's chest like an invisible mountain peak, the pressure beyond words causing his blood throughout his body to nearly solidify. The surrounding space twisted into countless fragments, each reflecting those cold eyes—it held no anger, no mockery, simply pure "gazing," as if observing a chess piece attempting to leap off the board.

Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining frantically, that sensation of being watched making him nearly suffocate. Yet he forcibly halted his retreating footsteps, for with the Tianji Record's assistance, he glimpsed the true intention of that eye—this was not a killing blow, but a warning.

At that moment, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's arms vibrated violently. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a low sigh: "It has come... Every time you advance too quickly, it appears. This is the third time. Remember, the cost will grow heavier."

Chen Ji gritted his teeth, and under that formless gaze, spoke slowly, his voice hoarse yet resolute: "I know... but I must continue forward."

Heaven's Eye gave no response, yet that oppressive pressure vanished abruptly, leaving only words reverberating through Chen Ji's mind: "Next time, it cannot be taken back."

dialogue.content:
Next time... it cannot be taken back.

Chen Ji repeated these words, a bitter curve forming at the corner of his mouth. Heaven's Eye's warning had arrived earlier than anticipated, meaning his time was running short. The Heavenly Fate Value on the Tianji Record Fragment had already consumed nearly one-third, yet the complete version remained impossibly distant.

He drew a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. This was no time for self-pity. Ye Qing was still waiting for him outside, and the alliance's grand plan could not be delayed due to his personal affairs.

text.content:
The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the Heavenly Realm passage, familiar Spiritual Energy rushed toward him, carrying a faint scent of blood and scorched vegetation. He surveyed his surroundings and discovered he stood in a mountain valley, with the faint outline of the Tianqing Sect visible in the distance.

However, his good mood did not last long.

A cold mocking voice rang out from the shadows nearby: "Oh, isn't this our 'trash Senior Brother'? I thought you'd died in there."

dialogue.content:
A young man wearing Xuanwu Sect standardized armor emerged from the tree shadows, followed by over a dozen cultivators with extraordinary auras. The leader was robust and imposing, his features cold and stern, with a roaring Black Tortoise embroidered on his chest—it was Zhou Kuang, captain of Han Lie's personal guards, the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius.

Zhou Kuang examined Chen Ji up and down, his eyes filled with undisguised contempt: "This half-dead state, and you think yourself worthy of forming an alliance with our Xuanwu Sect? My Young Master said it clearly—instead of wasting time with a废物, we'd better just annex the Tianqing Sect and be done with it."

text.content:
Chen Ji stared at Zhou Kuang in silence, saying nothing. Thoughts rapidly flashed through his mind—why would Han Lie's people appear here? Where was Ye Qing? What about the other alliance members?

His instincts told him none of this was simple.

Seeing Chen Ji refuse to answer, Zhou Kuang grew even more smug, stepping forward: "What, scared speechless? Let me tell you, even if that demon woman Ye Qing came today, she couldn't protect you. I'd advise you to be sensible and withdraw from the alliance yourself, to save everyone the trouble—"

Before he could finish, a chilling wave of demonic energy suddenly descended.

dialogue.content:
"Save everyone what trouble?"

A clear, cold voice rang out from the void, followed by a black figure appearing beside Chen Ji as if materialized from thin air.

Ye Qing wore a black纱裙 long dress, her body surrounded by wisps of pale demonic mist. That beautiful face now carried a layer of frost. Her gaze swept over Zhou Kuang and the others, as if observing a group of ants.

"Zhou Kuang, correct? A dog under Han Lie's command." Ye Qing's voice carried not a trace of emotion, "You just said, who should be sensible?"

text.content:
Zhou Kuang's expression shifted slightly, but he soon recovered some of his arrogance: "Ye Saint, I respect you as a figure from the Demonic Path Holy Sect, but have you considered the consequences of opposing our Xuanwu Sect? My Young Master already had reservations about this alliance. If you persist in protecting this废物—"

"废物?" Ye Qing laughed lightly, that smile carrying a hint of mockery, "Your Han Lie fought me twelve times and lost eleven—that's the genius you're referring to?"

Zhou Kuang's face flushed red in an instant, yet he couldn't utter a word against Ye Qing's imposing presence.

Chen Ji stood to the side, taking everything in. He had wanted to speak缓和 the situation, but from deep within, a surge of indescribable rage arose.

废物. 废物. 废物.

He had heard these two words countless years, each time like a thorn piercing his heart. In the past, he could endure it, because endurance was his greatest weapon. But now, watching Ye Qing speak up for him, watching these clowns swagger before him, he suddenly felt there were some things that should no longer be endured.

Yet reason told him, the time had not yet come.

choice.prompt: Zhou Kuang's provocation continued, and while Ye Qing suppressed him, the situation grew increasingly tense. You need to make a choice:

choices.description: Temporarily retreat, letting Ye Qing continue to suppress the enemy. Preserve strength and wait for a better opportunity.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the status quo and avoid escalating the conflict
choices.risk_hint: If you continue to swallow your anger, it may affect how the alliance views you internally

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji slightly lowered his eyes, forcibly suppressing the fire in his heart. He gently tugged at Ye Qing's sleeve, murmuring: "There's no need to lose your temper over someone like this."

Seeing this, Zhou Kuang grew even more smug, coldly laughing: "What, the废物wants to be a turtle?"

Ye Qing glanced at Chen Ji, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes. She had wanted to say more, but meeting those calm, still-water eyes of Chen Ji, she ultimately chose silence.

She knew Chen Ji must have his reasons for acting this way, but the flames of frustration in her heart burned brighter and brighter.

text.content: Just then, a Demonic Path cultivator flew over urgently and whispered something into Ye Qing's ear. Ye Qing's expression shifted slightly, her gaze toward Zhou Kuang growing even colder: "So you came for this..."

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to peer into Zhou Kuang's background, find his weaknesses, and provide Ye Qing with intelligence support when necessary.
choices.risk_hint: The use of Tianji Record will attract attention

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fingers subtly forming a formation seal. An intangible force surged from the fragment in his embrace, and he felt his vision blur momentarily. Then Zhou Kuang's surrounding aura and meridians clearly presented themselves before his eyes.

"Found it..." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. "That jade pendant at his waist was bestowed by Han Lie as a protective talisman, but as long as we break through this layer of protection—"

text.content:
Chen Ji quietly approached Ye Qing, speaking in a voice only the two of them could hear: "His protective talisman is at his left waist. It can be broken with cold-ice True Qi. After breaking the talisman, his dantian will be exposed for three breaths."

Ye Qing slightly glanced sideways, her gaze at Chen Ji carrying a deeper meaning, but she said nothing, merely nodding lightly.

The next instant, Ye Qing moved.

A surge of extreme cold demonic energy swept through like a blizzard. Zhou Kuang didn't even have time to react before the jade pendant at his waist shattered into countless fragments. His pupils dilated sharply as he realized with horror that his surrounding protective spiritual light was dissipating.

"You—!"

choices.description: No longer holding back, publicly counterattacking Zhou Kuang with sharp words, letting him understand what true humiliation means.
choices.risk_hint: Exposing True Strength May Draw More Attention

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji suddenly let out a light laugh, that sound unusually clear in the silent valley.

"Waste?" He slowly stepped forward, locking eyes with Zhou Kuang. "Han Lie fought you twelve times and lost eleven. Tell me, is he a waste or a genius?"

"Moreover," Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned sharp, "if a waste could make Han Lie lose so many times, then what is Han Lie? Worse than waste?"

Zhou Kuang's face instantly flushed to a liver-colored red, but he was choked speechless. The Xuanwu Sect disciples behind him exchanged glances, and for a moment, no one dared speak.

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't look at him again, turning to walk toward Ye Qing as he said calmly: "Let's go. No need to stoop to the level of Han Lie's dog."

This remark, neither too loud nor too soft, happened to reach the ears of everyone present with perfect clarity.

However, Ye Qing did not follow Chen Ji to leave.

She stood quietly in place, the demonic energy around her growing denser. That chill made Zhou Kuang and the Xuanwu Sect disciples he brought instinctively retreat several steps.

"Zhou Kuang," Ye Qing's voice was terrifyingly calm, "I'll give you one more chance. Apologize to him."

A flash of hesitation crossed Zhou Kuang's face, but it was quickly replaced by arrogance: "Apologize? You want me to apologize to a waste? Lady Ye, you surely think highly of him!"

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's eyes surged with killing intent.

"Very well."

Her figure vanished from its location in an instant. The next moment, a vast demonic might descended from the heavens, directly pressing Zhou Kuang down to his knees. That force was like a mountain collapsing, leaving Zhou Kuang unable to even form a thought of resistance.

"Since you refuse to apologize, I'll have to teach you some manners."

Zhou Kuang let out a tragic scream, spraying a large mouthful of blood. The Xuanwu Sect disciples behind him wanted to step forward and help, but they were frozen in place by Ye Qing's single glance, unable to move.

text.content:
Chen Ji watched this scene, his brow slightly furrowing. He knew that Ye Qing doing this would bring great trouble—Xuanwu Sect was not to be trifled with, and Han Lie was someone who sought revenge for the slightest grievance.

But at the same time, a warm current surged in his heart.

In this world, except for his sister Chen Nian, it had been a long time since anyone was willing to do this for him.

"Ye Qing, that's enough." Chen Ji stepped forward, speaking softly.

Ye Qing slightly glanced sideways, her gaze at him carrying a hint of inquiry.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing stood up for Chen Ji and suppressed Zhou Kuang, but the way she looks at you seems to await your attitude. What will you do?

choices.description: Stop her from continuing to strike, calm things down, and prevent the situation from escalating further.
choices.visible_reward: Avoid Direct Conflict with Xuanwu Sect

text.content:
Chen Ji gently shook his head, stepping forward to grasp Ye Qing's wrist as he quietly said: "Enough. If this continues, someone will die."

Ye Qing was slightly startled, as if she hadn't expected Chen Ji to stop her. But she still restrained some of her demonic energy, coldly gazing at the collapsed Zhou Kuang on the ground.

"Go back and tell Han Lie, this is a warning. Next time, you won't be so lucky."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing withdrew her hand, turning to look at Chen Ji, a complex expression flickering in her eyes.

"You're always like this," she said softly. "You could have made them look even more humiliated, yet you insist on leaving room."

Chen Ji smiled, offering no answer. It wasn't that he didn't want Zhou Kuang to lose face, but he knew that now was not the time to completely break ties with Han Lie.

choices.description: Do not stop Ye Qing, let her continue to avenge you. Use her hand to suppress Zhou Kuang while observing the reactions of all parties.
choices.visible_reward: The pleasure of killing with a borrowed knife
choices.risk_hint: May cause dissatisfaction among other forces

text.content:
Chen Ji did not speak, only watching quietly as Ye Qing acted.

His silence itself was a stance. Ye Qing seemed to understand, the corner of her lips slightly lifting, the demonic energy in her palm growing more dense.

"Since my young master doesn't speak, I'll take it as your consent."

The words fell, and another wave of demonic energy roared out, directly destroying Zhou Kuang's cultivation!

dialogue.content:
Zhou Kuang let out a heart-wrenching scream, his whole body curling on the ground, convulsing.

Chen Ji watched this scene, a cold glint flashing in his eyes. He was no saint—if Zhou Kuang dared to provoke, he must be prepared to pay the price.

Moreover, this bill would eventually be charged to Han Lie's head. What concern was it of his?

"Let's go," Chen Ji said calmly, "It's time to return."

text.content:
Those Xuanwu Sect disciples looked at the paralyzed Zhou Kuang on the ground, their faces pale. They scrambled to lift their team leader and fled without looking back.

Peace returned to the valley, but everyone knew this matter would not end here.

Han Lie—that genius with reversed combat power—would never let this go.

choices.text: Tell Ye Qing to stop, but express that you will deal with Han Lie personally
choices.description: Tonight's events are just an appetizer; the real opponent is Han Lie himself. Express your determination.
choices.visible_reward: Make Ye Qing look at you with new eyes
choices.risk_hint: May attract Han Lie's direct attention

dialogue.content:
"Ye Qing, stop."

Chen Ji's voice was calm, yet carried unwavering determination. He walked slowly to Zhou Kuang, looking down at this once arrogant man.

"Go back and tell Han Lie," Chen Ji squatted down, meeting Zhou Kuang's gaze, "The alliance he wants, I can give. But if he dares call me 'trash' again—"

Chen Ji's eyes suddenly turned ice-cold: "I will let him know what true price means."

Ye Qing withdrew the demonic energy, her gaze toward Chen Ji carrying a new appreciation.

"Is this your true self?" she murmured softly, the corner of her lips curving up, "I thought you would keep enduring."

Chen Ji stood up, brushing the dust off his robe, and said calmly: "Endurance is necessary, but one must not be soft when it's time to act."

Ye Qing watched his retreating figure and suddenly laughed lightly: "Interesting, more and more interesting."

text.content:
Zhou Kuang was helped away by the Xuanwu Sect disciples, glaring fiercely at Chen Ji before leaving, that gaze full of hatred.

But Chen Ji didn't care.

Han Lie—he would have to face him sooner or later. Better to take the initiative than to wait passively. And tonight was merely a beginning.

Just then, a commotion came from the distance. A demonic path disciple flew over hastily and whispered something in Ye Qing's ear.

Ye Qing's expression changed slightly, her gaze toward Chen Ji becoming grave: "Something's wrong. There's a problem within our alliance."

Chen Ji frowned, about to ask for details, when a sharp sword aura suddenly descended from the heavens, rushing straight toward his face!

"How dare you!"

Ye Qing roared in anger, demonic energy forming a barrier before Chen Ji. The two forces collided with a deafening roar.

However, that sword aura wasn't meant to take Chen Ji's life—its true target was the demonic path mist Ye Qing used to conceal Chen Ji's presence!

"So that's how it is..." A glint of understanding flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, a cold smile curling his lips, "Someone wants to confirm the secret on me."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing withdrew the demonic energy, her expression gloomy as she gazed toward where the sword aura had come.

There stood three disciples in Tianqing Sect robes. The leader had handsome features but carried a sinister air.

"Senior Su?" Chen Ji recognized this person—Su Yunhe, the cousin of Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao. This man had always been at odds with Su Qingyao, yet appeared here now and had made a probing attack on him—

"Junior Chen," Su Yunhe sheathed his sword, looking at him with a mocking smile, "Long time no see. Junior's reputation seems to be growing more prominent, actually forming an alliance with the demonic path saint maiden. I wonder if this is the sect master's intention, or junior's own idea?"

text.content:
Chen Ji watched Su Yunhe quietly, his mind rapidly calculating.

Su Yunhe's appearance was no coincidence. His alliance with Ye Qing had already drawn dissatisfaction from certain parties, and now these people could no longer hold back and began to make moves.

More importantly—Su Yunhe's target wasn't just him, but also Ye Qing, and even the Tianqing Sect Master.

This was clearly a scheme to sow discord!

"Senior Su," Chen Ji smiled faintly, "You and I are both Tianqing Sect disciples. Now that the sect faces peril, forming alliances with various forces is only proper. If senior thinks there is something inappropriate, you may certainly report to the sect master."

Su Yunhe's expression changed slightly, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to respond so composedly.

choice.prompt: Su Yunhe's probe was interrupted, but he clearly wouldn't let this matter rest. Undercurrents are already stirring within the alliance—you must make a choice:

choices.description: Directly expose Su Yunhe's plot, making him humiliated before everyone, while warning others with ulterior motives.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji stepped forward, his gaze sharp as a blade: "Senior Su, I would like to ask you—"

"As a Tianqing Sect disciple, yet you acted擅自, attacking an ally during alliance deliberations—what principle is this?"

Su Yunhe's expression changed, about to defend himself, but Chen Ji gave him no chance:

"Moreover, the sect master long ago gave his approval for the alliance. Senior's actions today—does senior think the sect master's wise decision was mistaken, or does senior consider yourself more insightful than the sect master?"

text.content:
Su Yunhe's expression instantly turned ashen. He never expected that this "trash" Chen Ji would be so difficult to deal with, capping him with a massive accusation in just a few words.

The surrounding disciples also whispered among themselves, their gazes toward Su Yunhe carrying more than a few异样.

"You—!" Su Yunhe pointed at him, unable to speak for a long time.

Chen Ji only smiled faintly: "If senior has nothing else, junior will take his leave."

With that, Chen Ji turned and left, Ye Qing following closely behind.

Su Yunhe wanted to stop them but was forced back by Ye Qing's cold stare. He could only watch them leave, his expression shifting between阴晴不定.

"Trash... trash..." he murmured to himself, a trace of hatred flickering in his eyes, "One day, I will make you kneel before me and beg for mercy!"

choices.description: Surface concession, secretly memorize Su Yunhe's name, wait for the opportunity to settle accounts together. Stay low-key.
choices.risk_hint: Enemies may become even more aggressive

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji did not argue with Su Yunhe, only slightly cupped his hands: "Elder brother's admonishment is well-received, your disciple has learned."

With that, he turned and left, his demeanor calm and composed, as if nothing had just happened.

Su Yunhe was slightly stunned, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to yield so easily. He wanted to say something more, but found he had no excuse whatsoever.

text.content:
Ye Qing followed behind him. After walking a distance, she finally spoke: "Are you just going to let it go like that?"

Chen Ji's steps did not pause, yet a cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth: "Let it go? Chen Ji never does anything without certainty. Su Yunhe, I've made a note of him."

"Once the alliance matters are settled, I'll teach him what it means to settle scores later."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing looked at him, a hint of appreciation flickering in her eyes: "You certainly have composure."

Chen Ji stopped his steps and glanced back at her: "It's not composure, it's that the timing hasn't arrived yet."

His gaze was deep and tranquil: "Han Lie, Su Yunhe—they're nothing but jumping clowns. The true enemy has never been them."

Ye Qing slightly raised an eyebrow, seemingly thinking of something, and did not ask further.

The two walked side by side toward the alliance quarters, leaving a trail of faint footprints behind them.

choices.description: Take this opportunity to display magnanimity, win over those in the middle who are watching, and isolate the enemies.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji did not respond to Su Yunhe directly. Instead, he turned to the surrounding disciples who were watching and slightly cupped his hands: "Brothers and fellow disciples, please discern right from wrong regarding today's matter."

"The alliance is a necessary measure to address the coming great upheaval. Though Ye Saintess is from the Demonic Path, she shares common enemies with the Tianqing Sect. This alliance benefits both public and private interests."

text.content:
His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. Those disciples who had merely come to watch showed varied expressions—some thoughtful, some nodding slightly.

"As for Senior Su's concerns, your disciple understands as well." Chen Ji shifted his tone, "But your disciple believes that mutual support is the right path, compared to baseless suspicion."

This speech was flawless, neither directly conflicting with Su Yunhe nor placing himself on the moral high ground.

dialogue.content:
Su Yunhe's expression grew increasingly grim. He knew he had already lost this round—not in Chen Ji's eloquence, but in demeanor.

"Hmph!" He coldly snorted and left in a huff.

Chen Ji watched his departing figure, a slight smile playing at the corner of his lips. He knew Su Yunhe would not let this go, but that wasn't important.

What mattered was that he had left an impression of "humble, courteous, and considering the bigger picture" in everyone's mind.

Ye Qing observed all of this and suddenly said softly: "You're more interesting than I imagined."

text.content:
When they returned to the alliance quarters, the sky had gradually darkened.

Chen Ji stood at the door of his room, gazing at the brightly lit hall nearby, a complex expression flickering in his eyes.

Too much had happened today—the warning from the Heavenly Dao's Eye, Zhou Kuang's provocation, Su Yunhe's probing... each reminded him that this path was far more difficult than he had imagined.

But at the same time, he became even more certain of his choice.

Since the Heavenly Dao's Eye had warned him, it meant he was heading in the right direction. And the provocations from those jumping clowns would only make him more cautious, more determined.

Ye Qing had somehow walked to his side, following his gaze toward that hall.

"What are you thinking about?" she asked softly.

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then suddenly spoke: "Ye Qing, about today's matter... thank you."

This was the first time he had thanked her so formally.

Ye Qing was slightly stunned, then the corner of her mouth lifted: "Why thank me? You're my person, of course I protect you."

She said this as a matter of fact, as if stating an irrefutable truth.

Chen Ji looked at her and suddenly laughed softly: "My person?"

"Not convinced?" Ye Qing raised an eyebrow.

"Wouldn't dare." Chen Ji shook his head, yet a warm glint flickered in his eyes.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing looked at his side profile and suddenly became serious: "Chen Ji, I don't know what secrets you're hiding, but I can sense that you're carrying immense pressure."

Her voice was soft, yet carried a tenderness she had never shown before: "If you need help, you can tell me. I may not be able to solve your problems, but I can at least share some of your burden."

Chen Ji turned to look at her, meeting those sincere eyes.

At this moment, he suddenly felt that this ice-cold Saintess of the Demonic Path might not be as cold on the inside as she appeared.

"Alright." he replied softly.

text.content:
Ye Qing nodded satisfied and turned toward her quarters. Just before leaving, she suddenly stopped and looked back at Chen Ji.

Under the moonlight, that beautiful face of hers carried a faint smile.

"By the way," she suddenly spoke, her voice returning to its usual cold detachment, "Tomorrow the alliance has a meeting to discuss specific matters regarding resisting the Demonic Path invasion. As an important member, you must attend."

"Also," her tone slightly paused, "Word of you humiliating Zhou Kuang today should have already spread. Tomorrow Han Lie might come to you personally."

With that, she vanished into the night.

Chen Ji watched her departing figure, a grave look flickering in his eyes. Han Lie, eh... that heaven-defying genius of combat power, was finally going to make his appearance.

Night wind brushed past, stirring Chen Ji's robes.

He stood quietly in place, gazing up at the starry sky. Tonight's stars shone exceptionally bright, as if presaging something.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye's warning still echoed in his ears, the undercurrents within the alliance had already begun to surge, and that heaven-defying genius Han Lie would soon face him in direct confrontation.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, a resolute glint flashing in his eyes.

No matter how many difficulties lay ahead, he would walk this path step by step. Because in his heart burned a name he could never let go of—Chen Nian.

To find his sister, he was willing to make enemies of the entire world.

And now, he needed to deal with the troubles before him first.

Tomorrow... let's see who the real废物 is.
